answer.answer:
### Short answer
Current vault evidence does not provide a ranked “strongest” list for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense; it supports only a UAV-centered opportunity set, with explicit R&S RTO / MXO mappings in Taiwan UAV eco-chain rows and broader military / aviation drone demand context, while the same sources warn not to infer adoption, formal configurations, or rankings from the mappings [43][44][54][77].
### Recommended first targets
**UAV camera / image-processing interfaces** are the most explicit RTO / MXO opportunity in the vault because the UAV eco-chain mapping lists 邑錡 as image processor / Camera with GMSL and LVDS, and maps that row to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [43][51][52].
**UAV motor / gimbal and battery / power accounts** are explicit MXO opportunities because the mapping lists 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台 with R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 under 電池電源 with R&S MXO [43][47][51][52].
**High-speed PCB / SI / TDR discovery for A&D system houses** is a measurement-need opportunity rather than a confirmed oscilloscope product mapping, because R&S PCB test solutions list TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram, but the source does not provide formal product models, options, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods [80][81].
**Military / aviation drone EMC / EME programs** are an A&D demand context, but not a confirmed oscilloscope opportunity in the vault, because the drone solution evidence focuses on MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, EMI / EMS systems, and system-level EME rather than RTO / MXO [6][63][65][68].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Demand it can connect to | Confirmed option / spec in vault | Why it is evidence-backed | Evidence | Gap / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO | UAV image processor / Camera row with GMSL and LVDS at 邑錡.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, trigger, compliance package, or order number for this row.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps the 邑錡 GMSL / LVDS camera row to R&S RTO.[43][51][52] | RTO appears only as an R&S Solution mapping for 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | The mapping cannot be treated as a formal configuration, quote bundle, customer adoption, measurement uncertainty, or pass/fail setup.[44][50] |
| R&S MXO | UAV image processor / Camera GMSL / LVDS, motor / gimbal, and battery / power rows.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, power-analysis package, serial-bus package, or order number.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps MXO to 邑錡 for GMSL / LVDS, 其昜先進 in motor / gimbal, and 德鑫新技 in battery / power.[43][47][51][52] | MXO is listed in the UAV solution mapping for camera, motor / gimbal, and battery / power categories.[43][47][51][52] | The mapping cannot be rewritten as confirmed purchase, usage, evaluation, certification, formal setup, or complete test configuration.[44][50] |
| Unspecified R&S oscilloscope / TDR-capable discovery path | PCB fabricator and system-house flows involving TDR impedance, DK/DF, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram.[80] | 知識庫未標示 product model, option code, fixture, calibration method, test frequency, standard, or software configuration.[81] | The vault confirms the measurement workflow but does not confirm which oscilloscope product or option implements it.[80][81] | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement, Material / Stackup selection, Signal Integrity modeling / testing, Sampling testing, and Process Monitoring items including TDR and Eye diagram.[80] | This should be used only as discovery because the source is not a formal product portfolio, datasheet, configuration guide, or procurement configuration.[81] |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing supplier | R&S RTO or R&S MXO, as already mapped in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | Start from the 邑錡 row: image processor, Camera, GMSL, and LVDS.[43][51] | The vault does not provide interface test method, option code, bandwidth, probe model, compliance procedure, or customer status.[44][50] |
| UAV motor / gimbal supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台.[43][47][51] | Use the existing MXO mapping to qualify motor / gimbal measurement needs.[43][51] | The vault does not state the motor drive topology, PWM frequency, voltage/current ranges, probes, or pass/fail criteria.[44][50] |
| UAV battery / power supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 德鑫新技 under 電池電源.[43][47][51] | Use the MXO mapping together with drone component risks such as battery, BMS, ESC, flight control module, communication module, antennas, and sensors.[32][43][51] | The vault does not state that MXO measures those components, and it does not provide voltage, current, rail, probe, or power-analysis option details.[32][44][50] |
| A&D UAV system integrator or lab | Do not lead with Oscilloscope as confirmed; qualify whether the need is camera / power / motor / PCB / EMC first.[43][52][63] | The vault has UAV system-integrator and certification-lab rows, and the drone proposal has EMI / EMS standard-system evidence.[52][63] | The vault does not map RTO / MXO to system integrators or EMC labs as a confirmed oscilloscope setup, and it warns not to infer adoption or formal configuration.[44][52][63] |
| PCB / high-speed digital work in A&D accounts | 知識庫未證實 a specific oscilloscope product; use TDR / SI needs for discovery.[80][81] | Ask about impedance TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, crosstalk, Eye diagram, and SI modeling / testing.[80] | The vault does not provide product model, option code, standard version, fixture, calibration method, or formal R&S portfolio mapping.[81] |
### Evidence context
The A&D demand context is strongest around UAV / drone because the vault’s drone solution source covers military / aviation drones, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, and system-level EME effects testing [1][6][65][68].
The Taiwan UAV industry page covers military, commercial, consumer UAVs, defense procurement, non-red supply chain, international market expansion, and regulation / testing / policy leads [77].
### Inference lines
【推論】Battery, BMS, ESC, and UAV power-delivery topics can be used to qualify MXO discussions, but the vault only separately confirms those drone components and MXO battery / power mapping, not a validated MXO test method for those components.[32][42][43][44]
【推論】PCB / SI / TDR is a plausible discovery path for A&D system-house conversations, but it should not be quoted as an oscilloscope solution until product model, options, fixture, standard, and calibration evidence are added.[80][81]
### Limits
The R&S solution fields cannot be treated as formal configurations, quotation bundles, order numbers, license packages, measurement uncertainty statements, or pass/fail criteria [44].
UAVEcoChain is a lossy markdown derivative of an Excel file with no formal publication date, author, version, maintainer, or full context [49][50].
The vault’s PARPRO Aerospace & Defense source has not captured the page body, so it cannot confirm PARPRO’s aerospace, defense, space, certification, customer, supply-chain, or production details [25].

passages.text:
2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。
- 來源提出 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]]：standard system 包含 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS8997]]；customised solution 包含 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]。
- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。
- 軍用 / 航太部分，來源列出 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]]、[[DEF STAN 59-411]]、[[GJB 151B]]、[[GJB 1389A]] 等標準線索，並補充 [[MIL-STD-464]] 涵蓋 external RF EME、[[HPM]]、[[EMP]]、lightning、RADHAZ、HERP / HERF / HERO、electrical bonding、TEMPEST 與 platform radiated emission 等系統層議題。
- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

2025RS Drone Solution › Drone / UAV / UAS 概念
- [[UAV]] — 來源定義為 platform vehicle。
- [[UAS]] — 來源定義為 entire system that supports drone operation，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等。
- [[Drone EMC 測試]] — 來源核心議題，涵蓋 emissions、immunity、conducted layout、radiated layout、mounting mode、idle / active mode 與 EUT / AUT 環境。
- [[商用無人機 EMC standards]] — 來源整理 commercial drones 的 regulatory compliance、emission / immunity standards、Class A / Class B 與 application-dependent immunity level。
- [[軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing]] — 來源整理 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]] 與系統層 EME effects testing。
- [[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] — 來源摘要 [[RTCA DO-160]] Section 15、16、17、18、19、20、21、22、25，並將 Section 20 對應 RF susceptibility、Section 21 對應 RF emissions、Section 22 對應 lightning induced transients、Section 25 對應 ESD。

2025RS Drone Solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、版本、作者、客戶、適用國家 / 地區或簡報完整頁數；只能以 raw 轉檔日期 2026-09-17 與檔名 `2025RS` 追溯。
- 轉檔為 lossy derivative；多個表格與標準列名存在 OCR / 排版斷裂，例如 standards based on EUT、R&S test system list、ETSI 4709-x 描述與 MIL / satellite standards 表。
- [[R&S TS8997]] 只出現代碼；來源未說明完整產品名稱或用途。
- [[MIL-STD-464]] 在來源中同時出現 464C 與 464D，未說明版本差異或適用情境。
- `Lighting` / `Lightning` 在來源中皆出現，需回 PDF 判斷是 illumination 還是 lightning / EMP 語境。
- `DAV-B` 可能為 `DVB` 或其他 broadcast emission 文字；未決。
- [[ETSI 4709-x]] 的正式標準名稱、版本與 drone network testing 關係未由來源清楚標示。
- 來源列出的 standard applicability 不等於任一 drone product 必須全部測試；測試項目需依 EUT、intended environment、regulatory domain、application 與 manufacturer requirement 定義。
- 來源列 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]，但未提供 test method、frequency plan、chamber / antenna setup、pass / fail criteria、threat waveform 或 safety condition。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › Complex EME emulation
來源的 RF electromagnetic environment 章節列出：

- emulate complex EME signals。
- enable the military electromagnetic spectrum operation。
- emulating different electromagnetic environment。
- evaluating military system level effects under EM interferences。
- simulating different operational scenarios。

這支持 [[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 的客製化測試方向，但來源未提供 signal library、scenario definition、threat emitter model、功率、頻段、同步或安全條件。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

- Rotor motors 需要 stable 48V 580W rail。
- Stable 48V 580W rail 由 two PRM regulators array 提供。
- On-board electronics 的 12V 100W rail 由 half-chip PRM 調節 fuel cell output，再由 ZVS Buck regulator 將 48V PRM output 轉換為 12V。
- Complete PDN efficiency：97%。
- PDN weight：35g。
- 重量為 comparable brick solution 的 10%。

- [[Fixed-ratio converter]] — 本次建立的概念頁，整理 fixed-ratio / bus converter、K factor、SELV、parallel operation、SAC topology 與 PDN implications。
- [[Power Delivery Network]] — 文件用 PDN 描述 cables、bus bars、connectors、circuit board copper power planes、power converters 與 regulators。
- [[DC-DC converter]] — 文件將 regulated / non-regulated、isolated / non-isolated converters 分層。
- [[Zero-Voltage Switching]] — DCM、ZVS buck、ZVS buck-boost 與 PRM 相關拓撲語彙。
- [[Sine Amplitude Converter]] — Vicor SAC topology，用於 Vicor converter modules。
- [[SELV]] — 來源提到從 high voltage 轉換到 safety extra low voltage level PDN。
- [[UAV Power system and Battery 外部資料清單]] — 既有頁先前把 [[Vicor-UAV-eBook]] 視為未擷取 PDF；本來源是該 PDF / eBook 內容的摘要。

Vicor-UAV-eBook › 重點摘要
- 文件主題是使用 high density power conversion 與 [[UAV 48V power architecture]] 改善 UAV 的 range、flight time、payload capacity 與 power distribution。
- 文件將 UAV performance 描述為 range、flight time、payload capacity、fast communications 的綜合結果；提高 range 與 payload capacity 通常需要更高 power levels，但會與 lightweight、compact designs 衝突。
- 文件涵蓋 tethered drone、vertical take-off and landing drone、high-altitude long-endurance drone 等 UAV 類型，但重點是 power delivery network 與 Vicor 模組化 power solution。
- Case studies 包含 Delivery UAVs、Agricultural UAVs、Surveillance UAVs、Inspection UAVs、Fukaden communications tethered drone 與 Doosan hydrogen powered UAV。
- Delivery UAVs 案例強調 redundant power 給 motors、GPS navigation、vision systems、flight sensors、flight termination sensors；來源列出的 PDN 產品為 PI33xx ZVS buck 與 PI37xx ZVS buck-boost。
- Agricultural、Surveillance 與 Inspection UAVs 案例均使用 DCM DC-DC converters 搭配 ZVS buck / buck-boost regulators，主張 compact、lightweight、high efficiency 可延長 flight time、改善 thermal management 並保留 payload space。
- Fukaden communications tethered drone 案例描述災害通訊用途；來源說 Fukaden drones 需要 1kW 至 5kW power，communication station requires up to 9kW，使用 DC 700V、thinner tether 與 three high voltage Vicor BCM fixed-ratio converters in parallel，可達 92 hours 飛行並維持 10km communication area diameter。
- Doosan hydrogen powered UAV 案例描述 2.6kW hydrogen fuel cell solution；fuel cell voltage varied from 40 to 74V，rotor motors 需要 stable 48V 580W rail，由 two PRM regulators array 提供；complete PDN efficiency 為 97%，PDN weight 為 35g。
- Technical articles 比較 power module 與 discrete power solution，並主張 Vicor power modules 在 size、weight、power density、scalability、thermal management、assembly 與 supply chain 上有優勢。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming
[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

### Short answer
Current vault evidence does not provide a ranked “strongest” list for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense; it supports only a UAV-centered opportunity set, with explicit R&S RTO / MXO mappings in Taiwan UAV eco-chain rows and broader military / aviation drone demand context, while the same sources warn not to infer adoption, formal configurations, or rankings from the mappings [43][44][54][77].
### Recommended first targets
**UAV camera / image-processing interfaces** are the most explicit RTO / MXO opportunity in the vault because the UAV eco-chain mapping lists 邑錡 as image processor / Camera with GMSL and LVDS, and maps that row to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [43][51][52].
**UAV motor / gimbal and battery / power accounts** are explicit MXO opportunities because the mapping lists 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台 with R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 under 電池電源 with R&S MXO [43][47][51][52].
**High-speed PCB / SI / TDR discovery for A&D system houses** is a measurement-need opportunity rather than a confirmed oscilloscope product mapping, because R&S PCB test solutions list TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram, but the source does not provide formal product models, options, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods [80][81].
**Military / aviation drone EMC / EME programs** are an A&D demand context, but not a confirmed oscilloscope opportunity in the vault, because the drone solution evidence focuses on MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, EMI / EMS systems, and system-level EME rather than RTO / MXO [6][63][65][68].
### Product and option mapping

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO | UAV image processor / Camera row with GMSL and LVDS at 邑錡.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, trigger, compliance package, or order number for this row.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps the 邑錡 GMSL / LVDS camera row to R&S RTO.[43][51][52] | RTO appears only as an R&S Solution mapping for 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | The mapping cannot be treated as a formal configuration, quote bundle, customer adoption, measurement uncertainty, or pass/fail setup.[44][50] |
| R&S MXO | UAV image processor / Camera GMSL / LVDS, motor / gimbal, and battery / power rows.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, power-analysis package, serial-bus package, or order number.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps MXO to 邑錡 for GMSL / LVDS, 其昜先進 in motor / gimbal, and 德鑫新技 in battery / power.[43][47][51][52] | MXO is listed in the UAV solution mapping for camera, motor / gimbal, and battery / power categories.[43][47][51][52] | The mapping cannot be rewritten as confirmed purchase, usage, evaluation, certification, formal setup, or complete test configuration.[44][50] |
| Unspecified R&S oscilloscope / TDR-capable discovery path | PCB fabricator and system-house flows involving TDR impedance, DK/DF, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram.[80] | 知識庫未標示 product model, option code, fixture, calibration method, test frequency, standard, or software configuration.[81] | The vault confirms the measurement workflow but does not confirm which oscilloscope product or option implements it.[80][81] | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement, Material / Stackup selection, Signal Integrity modeling / testing, Sampling testing, and Process Monitoring items including TDR and Eye diagram.[80] | This should be used only as discovery because the source is not a formal product portfolio, datasheet, configuration guide, or procurement configuration.[81] |
### Scenario entry points

| UAV camera / image-processing supplier | R&S RTO or R&S MXO, as already mapped in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | Start from the 邑錡 row: image processor, Camera, GMSL, and LVDS.[43][51] | The vault does not provide interface test method, option code, bandwidth, probe model, compliance procedure, or customer status.[44][50] |
| UAV motor / gimbal supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台.[43][47][51] | Use the existing MXO mapping to qualify motor / gimbal measurement needs.[43][51] | The vault does not state the motor drive topology, PWM frequency, voltage/current ranges, probes, or pass/fail criteria.[44][50] |
| UAV battery / power supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 德鑫新技 under 電池電源.[43][47][51] | Use the MXO mapping together with drone component risks such as battery, BMS, ESC, flight control module, communication module, antennas, and sensors.[32][43][51] | The vault does not state that MXO measures those components, and it does not provide voltage, current, rail, probe, or power-analysis option details.[32][44][50] |
| A&D UAV system integrator or lab | Do not lead with Oscilloscope as confirmed; qualify whether the need is camera / power / motor / PCB / EMC first.[43][52][63] | The vault has UAV system-integrator and certification-lab rows, and the drone proposal has EMI / EMS standard-system evidence.[52][63] | The vault does not map RTO / MXO to system integrators or EMC labs as a confirmed oscilloscope setup, and it warns not to infer adoption or formal configuration.[44][52][63] |
| PCB / high-speed digital work in A&D accounts | 知識庫未證實 a specific oscilloscope product; use TDR / SI needs for discovery.[80][81] | Ask about impedance TDR, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, crosstalk, Eye diagram, and SI modeling / testing.[80] | The vault does not provide product model, option code, standard version, fixture, calibration method, or formal R&S portfolio mapping.[81] |
### Evidence context
The A&D demand context is strongest around UAV / drone because the vault’s drone solution source covers military / aviation drones, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, and system-level EME effects testing [1][6][65][68].
The Taiwan UAV industry page covers military, commercial, consumer UAVs, defense procurement, non-red supply chain, international market expansion, and regulation / testing / policy leads [77].
### Inference lines
【推論】Battery, BMS, ESC, and UAV power-delivery topics can be used to qualify MXO discussions, but the vault only separately confirms those drone components and MXO battery / power mapping, not a validated MXO test method for those components.[32][42][43][44]
【推論】PCB / SI / TDR is a plausible discovery path for A&D system-house conversations, but it should not be quoted as an oscilloscope solution until product model, options, fixture, standard, and calibration evidence are added.[80][81]
### Limits
The R&S solution fields cannot be treated as formal configurations, quotation bundles, order numbers, license packages, measurement uncertainty statements, or pass/fail criteria [44].
UAVEcoChain is a lossy markdown derivative of an Excel file with no formal publication date, author, version, maintainer, or full context [49][50].
The vault’s PARPRO Aerospace & Defense source has not captured the page body, so it cannot confirm PARPRO’s aerospace, defense, space, certification, customer, supply-chain, or production details [25].

Vicor-UAV-eBook › 重點摘要
- 文件主題是使用 high density power conversion 與 [[UAV 48V power architecture]] 改善 UAV 的 range、flight time、payload capacity 與 power distribution。
- 文件將 UAV performance 描述為 range、flight time、payload capacity、fast communications 的綜合結果；提高 range 與 payload capacity 通常需要更高 power levels，但會與 lightweight、compact designs 衝突。
- 文件涵蓋 tethered drone、vertical take-off and landing drone、high-altitude long-endurance drone 等 UAV 類型，但重點是 power delivery network 與 Vicor 模組化 power solution。
- Case studies 包含 Delivery UAVs、Agricultural UAVs、Surveillance UAVs、Inspection UAVs、Fukaden communications tethered drone 與 Doosan hydrogen powered UAV。
- Delivery UAVs 案例強調 redundant power 給 motors、GPS navigation、vision systems、flight sensors、flight termination sensors；來源列出的 PDN 產品為 PI33xx ZVS buck 與 PI37xx ZVS buck-boost。
- Agricultural、Surveillance 與 Inspection UAVs 案例均使用 DCM DC-DC converters 搭配 ZVS buck / buck-boost regulators，主張 compact、lightweight、high efficiency 可延長 flight time、改善 thermal management 並保留 payload space。
- Fukaden communications tethered drone 案例描述災害通訊用途；來源說 Fukaden drones 需要 1kW 至 5kW power，communication station requires up to 9kW，使用 DC 700V、thinner tether 與 three high voltage Vicor BCM fixed-ratio converters in parallel，可達 92 hours 飛行並維持 10km communication area diameter。
- Doosan hydrogen powered UAV 案例描述 2.6kW hydrogen fuel cell solution；fuel cell voltage varied from 40 to 74V，rotor motors 需要 stable 48V 580W rail，由 two PRM regulators array 提供；complete PDN efficiency 為 97%，PDN weight 為 35g。
- Technical articles 比較 power module 與 discrete power solution，並主張 Vicor power modules 在 size、weight、power density、scalability、thermal management、assembly 與 supply chain 上有優勢。

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。
- 來源定義 [[UAV]] 為 platform vehicle，[[UAS]] 為支援 drone operation 的整體系統，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等；並列出 battery、[[BMS]]、[[ESC]]、[[Flight Control Module]]、[[Communication Module]]、antennas 與 sensors 等 drone components。
- 來源提出 [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]]：standard system 包含 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS8997]]；customised solution 包含 [[B-RID Environment Performance]]、[[CUAS System Performance Verification]]、[[Electromagnetic Environment Emulation]] 與 [[High-Intensity RF]]。
- 商用無人機部分，來源列出 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU、[[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU、[[ETSI EN 301 489]] 系列、[[CISPR 32]] / [[EN 55032]]、[[CISPR 35]]、[[EN 61000-4-3]]、[[EN 61000-4-6]]、[[EN 61000-4-2]]、[[EN 61000-4-4]]、[[EN 61000-4-5]]、[[EN 61000-4-11]]、[[EN 61000-3-2]]、[[EN 61000-3-3]] 與 [[ISO 7637-2]] 等線索。
- 軍用 / 航太部分，來源列出 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]]、[[DEF STAN 59-411]]、[[GJB 151B]]、[[GJB 1389A]] 等標準線索，並補充 [[MIL-STD-464]] 涵蓋 external RF EME、[[HPM]]、[[EMP]]、lightning、RADHAZ、HERP / HERF / HERO、electrical bonding、TEMPEST 與 platform radiated emission 等系統層議題。
- 來源指出 commercial drone radiated RF immunity default test level 為 3 V/m、frequency range 80 MHz to 6 GHz，但也問「Is this test level adequate for all environment?」，並指出 test level 需由 drone manufacturer 依 applications 定義，例如 higher test level 10 V/m 或 specialized test level。

2025RS Drone Solution › Drone / UAV / UAS 概念
- [[UAV]] — 來源定義為 platform vehicle。
- [[UAS]] — 來源定義為 entire system that supports drone operation，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等。

- [[商用無人機 EMC standards]] — 來源整理 commercial drones 的 regulatory compliance、emission / immunity standards、Class A / Class B 與 application-dependent immunity level。
- [[軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing]] — 來源整理 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]] 與系統層 EME effects testing。
- [[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] — 來源摘要 [[RTCA DO-160]] Section 15、16、17、18、19、20、21、22、25，並將 Section 20 對應 RF susceptibility、Section 21 對應 RF emissions、Section 22 對應 lightning induced transients、Section 25 對應 ESD。

2025RS Drone Solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、版本、作者、客戶、適用國家 / 地區或簡報完整頁數；只能以 raw 轉檔日期 2026-09-17 與檔名 `2025RS` 追溯。

- `DAV-B` 可能為 `DVB` 或其他 broadcast emission 文字；未決。
- [[ETSI 4709-x]] 的正式標準名稱、版本與 drone network testing 關係未由來源清楚標示。
- 來源列出的 standard applicability 不等於任一 drone product 必須全部測試；測試項目需依 EUT、intended environment、regulatory domain、application 與 manufacturer requirement 定義。

來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 setup
白皮書中的 August 2025 測試 setup：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- CMX500 configured device 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- control PC command CMX500；measurement PC command UE。
- M.2 modem 透過 USB adapter board 存取 [[AT command]] port，並以 RF cables 直接連到 CMX500 RF ports。
- phones 使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 測試三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41 / 2.50713 GHz、n78 / 3.30087 GHz、n79 / 4.62399 GHz。
- UE received power 固定 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping 100 Hz；iPerf update 每秒一次；uplink / downlink target data rate 2 Mbit/s。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

來源沒有提供具體 EUT 型號、BOM、電壓、介面或測試 setup；因此本頁只記錄這些是測試風險與待測元件線索。

Drone EMC 測試
[[Drone EMC 測試]] 是針對 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在預期操作環境中對 electromagnetic emissions 與 electromagnetic immunity 的符合性與可靠性驗證。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

UAV 48V power architecture › Doosan hydrogen powered UAV
[[Vicor-UAV-eBook]]（Rev 2.1，8/2025）描述 Doosan 透過 miniaturizing hydrogen fuel cell technology 開發 2.6kW fuel cell solution。

來源列出的重點：

- Small UAVs 小於 25kG 使用 Li-Ion technology 擴展 operational range 具有挑戰，來源稱 flight times 通常 below 30 minutes。
- Doosan 2.6kW fuel cell solution 相較 conventional battery solutions 通常重量為一半，power density 通常為兩倍。
- Hydrogen fuel cells output 會依 state of charge 與 load current 大幅變動。
- Doosan 案例中 fuel cell voltage varied from 40 to 74V。
- Rotor motors 需要 stable 48V 580W rail。
- Stable 48V 580W rail 由 two PRM regulators array 提供。
- On-board electronics 的 12V 100W rail 由 half-chip PRM 調節 fuel cell output，再由 ZVS Buck regulator 將 48V PRM output 轉換為 12V。
- Complete PDN efficiency：97%。
- PDN weight：35g。
- 重量為 comparable brick solution 的 10%。

以上內容是 Vicor eBook 中的 case study 說法；來源未提供第三方測試資料、完整比較產品、飛行環境或 certification。

UAV 48V power architecture › Fukaden communications tethered drone
[[Vicor-UAV-eBook]]（Rev 2.1，8/2025）描述 Fukaden communications tethered drone 用於 natural disasters 中恢復 uninterrupted wireless communications。

來源列出的重點：

- Fukaden drones 需要 1kW 至 5kW power。
- Communication station requires up to 9kW。
- Fukaden 使用 higher voltage 700V、thinner tether、three high voltage Vicor BCM fixed-ratio converters in parallel。
- Vicor solution key benefits 包含 up to 776W/in³ power density 與 integrated EMI filtering。
- 該 PDN 可讓 drone 飛行 92 hours，並維持 communication area diameter of 10km。

來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 25 — Electrostatic Discharge
來源說此測試確保 equipment able to withstand an air discharged electromagnetic pulse，並指出 static electricity charges can result from human contact；contributing factors include low humidity、low temperature、low conductivity、carpets、vinyl seats and plastic structures。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 15 — Magnetic Effect
來源說 Section 15 concern 為 equipment magnetic effect，目標是 finding or proving the closest distance to compasses or compass sensors（flux gates）at which that unit is allowed to be installed。

來源列出 classification：Cat Y、Cat Z、Cat A、Cat B、Class C，其中 Cat Y 被描述為 equipment next to navigation compass，Class C 被描述為 equipment >3.0 m from navigation compass。來源未提供完整 category definition。

[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

NTN signal generator solutions › 使用限制
- 來源是 2025 簡報與 OneNote 轉檔，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、price book 或 3GPP specification。
- 來源標示 12-2025、Last updated 08/25 與 2025-09-29 workshop date；正式發布日期未標示。
- 來源中的 recommended configurations 不能直接視為可報價 BOM；需回查正式 configuration guide、option availability、export control 與 service plan。
- 來源中的 R17/18 option wording 不可直接覆寫正式 product option name；正式命名仍以產品規格書為準。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

### Short answer
Current vault evidence does not provide a ranked “strongest” list for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense; it supports only a UAV-centered opportunity set, with explicit R&S RTO / MXO mappings in Taiwan UAV eco-chain rows and broader military / aviation drone demand context, while the same sources warn not to infer adoption, formal configurations, or rankings from the mappings [43][44][54][77].
### Recommended first targets
**UAV camera / image-processing interfaces** are the most explicit RTO / MXO opportunity in the vault because the UAV eco-chain mapping lists 邑錡 as image processor / Camera with GMSL and LVDS, and maps that row to R&S RTO and R&S MXO [43][51][52].
**UAV motor / gimbal and battery / power accounts** are explicit MXO opportunities because the mapping lists 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台 with R&S MXO and 德鑫新技 under 電池電源 with R&S MXO [43][47][51][52].
**High-speed PCB / SI / TDR discovery for A&D system houses** is a measurement-need opportunity rather than a confirmed oscilloscope product mapping, because R&S PCB test solutions list TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram, but the source does not provide formal product models, options, standards, fixtures, or calibration methods [80][81].
**Military / aviation drone EMC / EME programs** are an A&D demand context, but not a confirmed oscilloscope opportunity in the vault, because the drone solution evidence focuses on MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, EMI / EMS systems, and system-level EME rather than RTO / MXO [6][63][65][68].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Demand it can connect to | Confirmed option / spec in vault | Why it is evidence-backed | Evidence | Gap / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO | UAV image processor / Camera row with GMSL and LVDS at 邑錡.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, trigger, compliance package, or order number for this row.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps the 邑錡 GMSL / LVDS camera row to R&S RTO.[43][51][52] | RTO appears only as an R&S Solution mapping for 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | The mapping cannot be treated as a formal configuration, quote bundle, customer adoption, measurement uncertainty, or pass/fail setup.[44][50] |
| R&S MXO | UAV image processor / Camera GMSL / LVDS, motor / gimbal, and battery / power rows.[43][51] | 知識庫未標示 option code, bandwidth, probe, power-analysis package, serial-bus package, or order number.[44] | The current vault explicitly maps MXO to 邑錡 for GMSL / LVDS, 其昜先進 in motor / gimbal, and 德鑫新技 in battery / power.[43][47][51][52] | MXO is listed in the UAV solution mapping for camera, motor / gimbal, and battery / power categories.[43][47][51][52] | The mapping cannot be rewritten as confirmed purchase, usage, evaluation, certification, formal setup, or complete test configuration.[44][50] |
| Unspecified R&S oscilloscope / TDR-capable discovery path | PCB fabricator and system-house flows involving TDR impedance, DK/DF, insertion loss, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling, and Eye diagram.[80] | 知識庫未標示 product model, option code, fixture, calibration method, test frequency, standard, or software configuration.[81] | The vault confirms the measurement workflow but does not confirm which oscilloscope product or option implements it.[80][81] | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement, Material / Stackup selection, Signal Integrity modeling / testing, Sampling testing, and Process Monitoring items including TDR and Eye diagram.[80] | This should be used only as discovery because the source is not a formal product portfolio, datasheet, configuration guide, or procurement configuration.[81] |
### Scenario entry points

|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing supplier | R&S RTO or R&S MXO, as already mapped in the UAV eco-chain.[43][51][52] | Start from the 邑錡 row: image processor, Camera, GMSL, and LVDS.[43][51] | The vault does not provide interface test method, option code, bandwidth, probe model, compliance procedure, or customer status.[44][50] |
| UAV motor / gimbal supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 其昜先進 under 馬達動力雲台.[43][47][51] | Use the existing MXO mapping to qualify motor / gimbal measurement needs.[43][51] | The vault does not state the motor drive topology, PWM frequency, voltage/current ranges, probes, or pass/fail criteria.[44][50] |
| UAV battery / power supplier | R&S MXO, as mapped to 德鑫新技 under 電池電源.[43][47][51] | Use the MXO mapping together with drone component risks such as battery, BMS, ESC, flight control module, communication module, antennas, and sensors.[32][43][51] | The vault does not state that MXO measures those components, and it does not provide voltage, current, rail, probe, or power-analysis option details.[32][44][50] |
| A&D UAV system integrator or lab | Do not lead with Oscilloscope as confirmed; qualify whether the need is camera / power / motor / PCB / EMC first.[43][52][63] | The vault has UAV system-integrator and certification-lab rows, and the drone proposal has EMI / EMS standard-system evidence.[52][63] | The vault does not map RTO / MXO to system integrators or EMC labs as a confirmed oscilloscope setup, and it warns not to infer adoption or formal configuration.[44][52][63] |

### Evidence context
The A&D demand context is strongest around UAV / drone because the vault’s drone solution source covers military / aviation drones, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, and system-level EME effects testing [1][6][65][68].
The Taiwan UAV industry page covers military, commercial, consumer UAVs, defense procurement, non-red supply chain, international market expansion, and regulation / testing / policy leads [77].
### Inference lines
【推論】Battery, BMS, ESC, and UAV power-delivery topics can be used to qualify MXO discussions, but the vault only separately confirms those drone components and MXO battery / power mapping, not a validated MXO test method for those components.[32][42][43][44]
【推論】PCB / SI / TDR is a plausible discovery path for A&D system-house conversations, but it should not be quoted as an oscilloscope solution until product model, options, fixture, standard, and calibration evidence are added.[80][81]
### Limits
The R&S solution fields cannot be treated as formal configurations, quotation bundles, order numbers, license packages, measurement uncertainty statements, or pass/fail criteria [44].
UAVEcoChain is a lossy markdown derivative of an Excel file with no formal publication date, author, version, maintainer, or full context [49][50].
The vault’s PARPRO Aerospace & Defense source has not captured the page body, so it cannot confirm PARPRO’s aerospace, defense, space, certification, customer, supply-chain, or production details [25].

- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
